impact.thread_dump: The agent pauses the application's threads briefly (usually a few milliseconds, longer with thousands of threads) to record every thread's state, locks and up to 64 frames.
impact.thread_stack: The agent records one thread's state, locks and up to 64 frames. The application is not paused.
impact.self_diagnosis: The agent reports its own health: memory and CPU use, dropped data, module states and its effective configuration. The application is not affected.
impact.reload_config: The agent re-reads its local configuration file. Keys that can change at runtime take effect at once; the others need a restart.
impact.env_dump: The agent sends the JVM arguments, environment variables and system properties. Values of secret-like keys are masked by the agent before they leave the server.

visibility.thread_dump: Only you and administrators can read the result. It is stored encrypted for 30 days and every view is audited.
visibility.thread_stack: Only you and administrators can read the result. It is stored encrypted for 30 days and every view is audited.
visibility.self_diagnosis: Only you and administrators can read the full report. It is stored encrypted for 30 days.
visibility.reload_config: Only administrators can read the result. The request is audited.
visibility.env_dump: Only administrators can read the result. It is stored encrypted for 30 days and every view is audited.

reason.ttl: not sent within 60 s (the instance's session was busy or gone)
reason.rejected: the agent refused it (disabled by its configuration)
reason.cooldown: the agent asks to wait before running it again
reason.agent_failed: the agent could not run it
reason.agent_expired: the agent dropped it as expired
reason.invalid_result: the agent's result could not be read
reason.unknown: reason not known to this version

error.instance_offline: The instance is not connected. Commands can be sent only while its agent is online.
error.busy: Another command of this instance is running. Wait until it ends and try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many commands for this instance. Wait a minute and try again.
error.rate_limitedWait: Too many commands for this instance. Try again in {{seconds, number}} s.
error.secret_unavailable: The server has no master key, so command results cannot be stored. Ask an administrator to configure it.
error.forbidden: Your role cannot run or read this command.
error.not_owner: Only the user who requested this command and administrators can read it.
error.network: The server could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
error.other: The request failed. Try again; if it keeps failing, check the server log.

run.noAnswer: No answer from the agent in time. Check the history for its final state.

tab.viewerNotice: Running commands and reading their history needs the operator role.
tab.offlineHint: The instance is not connected now: a command will be refused until its agent is online.
tab.limits: One command at a time per instance, at most 10 per minute. A command not sent within 60 s expires.

dialog.title: Run {{command}}?
dialog.argHint: Digits only. A transaction ID records the thread that runs it now.

history.title: Command history
history.caption: Commands of this instance, newest first
history.auditNote: This history is the audit trail of the instance's commands: who asked, when, how long it took and what came back. Every request and every result view is also an audit record.
history.operatorOnly: The command history is shown to operators and administrators.
history.requesterUnknown: The server did not send the user name.
history.truncatedTitle: The result reached the size limit (1 MiB) and was cut.
history.empty: No command was run on this instance.
history.emptyHint: Run a command above; its request and result appear here.

result.title: Result: {{command}}
result.truncated: The result was cut at the size limit. The end is missing.
result.raw: The result is not in the expected format; it is shown as the agent sent it.

title.env_dump: Environment variables, system properties and JVM options

latest.adminOnly: Administrator permission required. Environment variables, system properties and JVM options are shown to administrators only.
latest.operatorOnly: Running a self diagnosis and reading its full report needs the operator role. The agent health summary above is public.

empty.env_dump: No environment dump yet. Run one to see the instance's environment (values of secret-like keys come masked).
empty.self_diagnosis: No self diagnosis that you can read yet. Run one to see the agent's own health and where each setting comes from.

latest.newerUnreadable: Another user ran a newer one. Only its requester and administrators can read it.
latest.showHint: Viewing a result is recorded in the audit log.

selfDiagnosis.noGauges: The agent reported no measured value.

envDump.maskNote: Values of secret-like keys are masked by the agent and shown as received. Argos never stores or shows the original.
envDump.maskedTitle: Masked by the agent: only the length is known.
envDump.noJvmArguments: The agent reported no JVM option.
envDump.truncated: The agent cut this dump at 256 KiB: some entries are missing.
envDump.unavailable: The JVM did not give these sections: {{sections}}.

dumps.compareLater: Comparing two dumps comes in a later version.
dumps.listEmpty: No thread dump of this instance yet.
dumps.emptyHint: Take a thread dump to see what every thread of this instance is doing.
dumps.operatorOnly: Thread dumps are shown to operators and administrators: they hold stack traces of the application.
dumps.notDump: The command in the address is not a thread dump.

viewer.deadlockFromAgent: Found by the agent (JVM deadlock detection).
viewer.deadlockFromGraph: Inferred from the locks in the dump: each thread waits for a lock held by the next one.
viewer.snapshotNote: As of the dump: the transaction may have ended since, and its detail appears once it is collected.
viewer.truncated: The dump reached the size limit (1 MiB) and was cut: some threads are missing. Download the full file to see what was kept.
viewer.depthCut: Some stacks reached the agent's limit of {{count, number}} frames and are cut at the bottom. Download the full file for the text as recorded.

stack.title: This thread's stack
stack.depthCut: The stack reached the agent's limit of {{count, number}} frames and is cut at the bottom.

match.other: The thread no longer runs transaction {{txId}}: it has moved on to another one.
match.unknown: The agent did not report which transaction the thread runs; it may have finished {{txId}}.
